text:
Noah R.: FYI HealthSys sent a PO + DPA redline during the demo. They're asking for BYOK (AWS KMS) and a 90-day purge for patient-adjacent artifacts. Need procurement path.
Clara S.: Uploaded files here: https://files.redwood.internal/healthsys/2026/poc_packet.zip
Darren (Solutions): BYOK ok for stored artifacts. Streaming inference + BYOK needs an ops note about key rotations affecting streams.
Priya (Legal): Reading the DPA. Two hot items: (A) backups deletion at 90 days (we typically keep 180) and (B) customer control over keys for model I/O  that triggers a security carveout.
Noah R.: HealthSys insists invoice must include budget code HS-2026-PO1 and they want DocuSign route: HealthSys Procurement -> HealthSys Legal -> Redwood Sales -> Redwood Finance -> Redwood Legal.
Priya (Legal): We can sign PO now only if we include conditional language: "Acceptance of PO is contingent on execution of mutually agreeable DPA/MSA within 30 days". Otherwise we risk mismatched terms.
Clara S.: They want to go-live asap after PO. SEs: do not onboard traffic before DPA agreed. Marking this in the playbook.
Darren (Solutions): Draft ops blurb for order form:
```
Customer-managed KMS (BYOK): Supported for storage and model artifacts. Key rotation may interrupt in-flight streaming sessions; recommended rotation window: weekly during a 2-4h maintenance window. Redwood will provide rotation playbook and assist during onboarding.
```
Priya (Legal): Add indemnity and responsibility clause for key compromise. I will draft the DPA reply and an exceptions log.
Noah R.: Procurement question: can we accept 99.5% monthly uptime for hosted endpoints? HealthSys wants SLA credits for outages.
Priya (Legal): Legal ok on 99.5% for hosted with standard credit schedule. Sales Ops/Finance need to confirm price impact.
FinBot: Routing note: attach project code HS-2026-PO1 to invoice fields.
Clara S.: DocuSign envelope requested. @DocuSignBot create envelope with signer order per Noah. Include field for project code and PO#.
DocuSignBot: Envelope created (draft): https://docusign.redwood/E-7021.
Noah R.: Pricing impact needed by 17:00 ET. If we accept 99.5% + BYOK ops support, expect uplift.
Darren (Solutions): Recommend temporary BYOK ops fee and an SLA uplift delta. I'll send numbers.
Priya (Legal): I'll post DPA response within 3 hours. If HealthSys pressures for production before DPA, escalate to Priya.
Clara S.: Note to Sales: allow PO signature with conditional clause, but set DocuSign to require acceptance of clause text by both parties.
Noah R.: Thanks everyone. I'll update HealthSys after Priya and Darren post drafts. SEs on standby for POC ramp once final sign-off. :thumbsup:
